quotes.name: Andre Turner
quotes.quote: I'm not sure what to make of this Pablo Almanzar guy throwing a no-hitter in his debut, it feels like something's off, like we're all just caught up in the excitement of it. I think the Tribune should ask if this is really what we should be focusing on, or if there's more to the story.
